title: Firewatch Ridge
wikitext:
[[File:Firewatch Ridge.jpg|thumb|Firewatch Ridge]]

'''Firewatch Ridge''' is where the main campsite of the [[Dark Iron clan|Dark Iron dwarves]] in [[Searing Gorge]] lies. It overlooks the great excavation site of the [[Cauldron]].  Dark Irons, their mechanical golems, and giant flame spiders cover most of the ridge, making it exceptionally dangerous for adventurers.
